rules.description: End replenishment planning at a manually reviewable recommendation, not a transfer/order action.

provenance.note: Oracle explicitly distinguishes recommendations from automatically created orders/transfers.

rules.description: Join inventory, demand, lead time, safety and capacity evidence for a bounded planning horizon.

provenance.note: Sources ground the concepts; exact computation below is invented company policy.

rules.description: Order recommendations use configured quantity multiples.

provenance.note: Only the multiple concept is source-backed; the unconditional ceiling is sample policy.

rules.description: Require exact fields, synthetic identifiers, distinct configured logical filenames, valid integer quantities/dates and unique business keys; reject malformed or contradictory evidence.

provenance.note: Synthetic file-bundle validation, not a vendor export or API schema.

rules.description: Subtract disjoint reserved/blocked physical stock once, use residual unreserved demand and never add closed or duplicated receipts.

provenance.note: Explicit export accounting convention prevents stock/commitment double counting.

rules.description: Use same-as-of snapshots, arrival=as_of+lead and inclusive coverage ending arrival+review-1; complete daily demand and one dispatch budget; at most366 days.

provenance.note: Bounded sample planning horizon, not an external scheduler.

rules.description: Only positive in-transit receipts inside coverage contribute; closed receipts zero, later receipts excluded, overdue receipts quarantine the pair.

provenance.note: No guessed receipt timing or real inventory movement.

rules.description: Pre-arrival lost demand is not a backlog. Raw need covers the maximum cumulative post-arrival deficit and final safety target; re-simulate actual proposed receipts.

provenance.note: Negative planning balances are not physical stock; later receipts cannot cure earlier lost demand.

rules.description: Ceil raw need to cases; sort priority/store/SKU; debit shared DC stock and case capacity once; optionally allow whole-case partial proposals and expose all constraints.

provenance.note: Invented deterministic allocation, not Microsoft minimum-maximum or Oracle engine parity.

rules.description: Emit all proposals, daily projections, inbound dispositions, DC controls and review exceptions; action_authorized is false.

provenance.note: No stock writes, orders, reservations, shipments or native execution claim.

steps.title: Load independent synthetic exports
steps.procedure: Read configured logical source roles from the JSON bundle without opening an endpoint or resolving arbitrary file paths.

steps.title: Validate inventory and coverage
steps.procedure: Validate exact fields, business keys, disjoint stock, date windows, positive case packs and complete residual demand.

steps.title: Join stores, routes and dated supply
steps.procedure: Join each store/SKU to exactly one route, DC inventory, dispatch capacity, daily demand and independent receipt identities; classify every receipt.

steps.title: Project stock before arrival
steps.procedure: Walk actual days in order, receive inbound before demand and record unfulfilled forecast as lost rather than backlog.

steps.title: Calculate raw need and whole-case request
steps.procedure: Compute unconstrained coverage balances, largest prefix deficit and final safety need; ceil the maximum need to case packs.

steps.title: Allocate shared DC constraints
steps.procedure: Walk priority/store/SKU candidates, limit by remaining DC SKU stock and dispatch-case capacity and record each hypothetical debit.

steps.title: Re-project and expose review exceptions
steps.procedure: Use actual proposed receipts in daily physical projection; expose deferred cases, dated lost demand, final safety shortfall and unresolved receipt timing.

steps.title: Publish complete review-only artifacts
steps.procedure: Publish all proposal rows, projections, receipt dispositions, stock/capacity controls, allocation ledger and human-review summary without a business action.
